mapper.insert: insert into conversation (user1_id, user2_id, create_time) values (#{user1Id}, #{user2Id}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select cu.conversation_id as conversationId, cu.unread_count as unreadCount, case when c.user1_id = #{userId} then c.user2_id else c.user1_id end as otherUserId, u.nickname, u.avatar, c.last_message as lastMessage, date_format(c.last_message_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastMessageTime from conversation_user cu join conversation c on cu.conversation_id = c.id join users u on (case when c.user1_id = #{userId} then c.user2_id else c.user1_id end) = u.id where cu.user_id = #{userId} order by c.last_message_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into conversation_user (conversation_id, user_id, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{createTime})
insert into private_message (conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update private_message set is_read = 1 where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and receiver_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
mapper.select: select id as messageId, sender_id as senderId, content, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from private_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by create_time desc
